latest_news.headline: Two more ships attacked in Hormuz as U.S. threatens additional pressure on Iran
latest_news.text: Reuters reports the UAE accused Iran of attacking two ADNOC-linked vessels transiting the Strait of Hormuz; public reporting also cited a drone strike and a UK maritime alert. Washington said its naval blockade can continue indefinitely and threatened further economic pressure as talks remained stalled. The attributed shipping attacks activate canonical ceasefire_violation; iran_conventional remains at its 95 raw / 100 coupled ceiling.
latest_news.source: Reuters / United Arab Emirates government / UKMTO

latest_news.headline: UN says RSF drone and siege pressure continues around El Obeid
latest_news.text: UN News reports RSF forces continue using attack drones and siege tactics against SAF-held El Obeid, while Sudan's war is driving severe civilian and medical deprivation in Darfur. This reconfirms the existing military_buildup and infrastructure_strike evidence; sudan remains at its 99% ceiling.

latest_news.headline: IAEA publishes Update 362 on the situation in Ukraine
latest_news.text: The IAEA's official news index published Update 362 on Ukraine. The statement body was not retrievable through the available direct-source path during this scan, so it is logged as a nuclear-safety watch item only; no configured russia_ukraine signal or probability change is inferred from the headline alone.

latest_news.headline: NATO mission jets shoot down unidentified drone over Latvia
latest_news.text: Reuters reports fighter jets on a NATO air-defence mission shot down a drone that entered Latvian airspace early Friday. Latvia initially gave no origin for the drone; Finland temporarily restricted parts of the eastern Gulf of Finland as a precaution. The interception adds to eastern-flank spillover pressure, but no injury, damage, Article 4/5 action or direct Russia-NATO exchange was reported. The russia tracker therefore holds at 70 raw / 80 coupled.
latest_news.source: Reuters / Latvian and Finnish defence authorities

latest_news.headline: U.N. warns Yemen is closest to major war since 2022 truce
latest_news.text: Reuters reports U.N. envoy Hans Grundberg warned that Yemen faces its most serious threat of a return to large-scale war since the 2022 truce. He cited intensified front-line activity, casualties, renewed Red Sea and Gulf of Aden attacks, and the risk of wider regional confrontation. The warning reinforces the active ceasefire_violation and infrastructure_strike evidence; yemen_red_sea holds at 90% because the tracker already prices sustained fighting and maritime escalation.

latest_news.headline: Houthis claim two-drone attack on Saudi Aramco refinery
latest_news.text: Reuters reports the Houthis said they attacked Saudi Aramco's Jazan refinery with two drones. Saudi Arabia had not commented, and damage or operational disruption was not independently confirmed. The claim renews canonical infrastructure_strike evidence without a further probability increment; yemen_red_sea remains 90/IMMINENT.

latest_news.headline: Ukraine offers mutual halt to attacks on civilian Black Sea targets
latest_news.text: Reuters reports Ukraine sent Russia a proposal for both sides to stop attacks on civilian Black Sea targets amid threats to food supplies. No Russian acceptance was reported, while attacks on ports, refineries and military infrastructure continued. The offer is a watch item rather than an active-negotiation threshold; russia_ukraine remains at 99%.

latest_news.text: Al Jazeera reports Israeli strikes killed Gaza City police chief Tareq Marouf and other Palestinians. Israel said one strike targeted a Hamas commander planning attacks. The reporting reconfirms the existing truce-breach warning; israel_palestine remains at its 99% ceiling.

latest_news.headline: USS George Washington heads toward Middle East as carrier rotation begins
latest_news.text: AP reports the USS George Washington crossed toward the Indian Ocean and is expected to replace the long-deployed USS Abraham Lincoln, preserving the two-carrier posture rather than adding a third carrier. The blockade remains in force and the defense secretary said it can be maintained indefinitely; no new configured deployment signal is applied.
latest_news.source: Associated Press / U.S. Navy / U.S. Defense Department

latest_news.headline: Israeli strikes in Gaza kill two, first fatalities in more than a week
latest_news.text: Reuters reports two people were killed in separate Israeli strikes in Gaza, the first fatalities from Israeli fire in more than a week. The strikes occurred despite the ceasefire and reconfirm canonical ceasefire_violation; israel_palestine remains at its 99% ceiling.

latest_news.headline: Israel conditions Lebanon withdrawal on Hezbollah disarmament
latest_news.text: Reuters reports Israel will not withdraw from southern Lebanon until Hezbollah is disarmed and ordered preparations for an extended presence. Hezbollah rejects weapons talks before Israeli withdrawal. diplomacy_refused activates alongside continuing diplomacy and ceasefire violations; probability stays at the 95/100 ceiling.

latest_news.headline: Iran and U.S. make competing claims over control of Hormuz
latest_news.text: Reuters reports Iran says the Strait is under its control and management while Washington says the U.S. Navy has total control. Commercial traffic remains severely constrained and no operational reopening was verified. This renews hormuz_controlled_not_closed without treating rhetoric as physical closure or zero traffic.

latest_news.headline: Türkiye, Pakistan and Saudi Arabia set pact coordination mechanisms
latest_news.text: Reuters reports Ankara says the three states will establish political and military mechanisms under their new defence pact. The pact is a major allied-position shift, but no public nuclear-sharing provision, Turkish missile test or official nuclear rhetoric crosses a configured Turkey threshold.

latest_news.headline: Israel-Lebanon talks continue while southern strikes persist
latest_news.text: Public reporting says Israel and Lebanon resumed U.S.-hosted talks, while Lebanon condemned fresh Israeli strikes in the south as unlawful. The paired evidence renews both diplomacy_active and ceasefire_violation; the raw/coupled score remains at its 95/100 ceiling.
latest_news.source: Reuters / Al Jazeera / News On AIR

latest_news.headline: Taiwan rehearses communications degradation during defence drill
latest_news.text: Associated Press reporting says Taiwan temporarily slowed mobile internet to text-only speeds during a civil-defence exercise simulating attack conditions. This is a Taiwanese resilience drill, not a new PRC military_buildup event; China remains 24 raw / 29 coupled.

latest_news.headline: Houthi-government clashes renew Yemen civil-war front
latest_news.text: AP reports overnight clashes in Taiz killed one government soldier and critically wounded another, while Yemeni artillery targeted Houthi movements in Marib. ceasefire_violation is renewed; no additional probability increment is applied because the tracker already prices sustained fighting and maritime strikes.

latest_news.headline: Ukraine hits fourth Russian refinery in three days
latest_news.text: AP reports Ukrainian drones struck the Gazprom Neftekhim Salavat complex 1,300 km from Ukraine, while Russian attacks with 133 long-range drones killed at least four people in Ukraine. This confirms sustained high-intensity war but does not cross a new configured russia_ukraine signal threshold; risk remains 99.
latest_news.source: Associated Press / Ukrainian and Russian officials

latest_news.headline: U.S. ambassador condemns settler siege in West Bank
latest_news.text: AP reports settlers besieged Palestinian homes in Qusra for days; the U.S. ambassador called it a horrific act of terror, while Israeli troops removed two outposts and reinforced the area. The event sharpens the West Bank watch but does not add a configured signal or lift the 99 ceiling.
latest_news.source: Associated Press / U.S. and Israeli officials

latest_news.headline: North Korea fires another ballistic missile before U.S.-ROK drills
latest_news.text: Reuters confirms a ballistic missile launch from the Wonsan area toward the sea east of the Korean Peninsula. It landed outside Japan’s exclusive economic zone. This renews missile_range_test; no nuclear test, ICBM impact or strike on another state was reported.

latest_news.headline: RSF renews al-Obeid assault as drones return to Sudanese capital
latest_news.text: Reuters reports eight drones targeted al-Obeid, killing two, while first-since-May drone strikes reached Khartoum and Atbara and both the army and RSF reinforced Kordofan. military_buildup and infrastructure_strike activate; Sudan rises 94→99.

latest_news.headline: Deadly Red Sea ship attack deepens Houthi blockade pressure
latest_news.text: Reuters reports four crew members were killed in the first deadly Houthi shipping strike of the Iran war, with two rescuers also killed; Red Sea traffic has fallen further and Saudi Red Sea oil exports have gone dark. This renews ceasefire_violation and infrastructure_strike without adding a second probability increment.

latest_news.source: Reuters / Spanish Defence Ministry / Moroccan Interior Ministry

evidence_for: U.N. warns Yemen is closest to major war since 2022 truce

dashboard_trackers.name: IRAN NUCLEAR
dashboard_trackers.notes: The IAEA/UN lane produced no fresh safeguards report and no verified threshold event involving enrichment, Fordow, weaponization or detonation. Atomic terms remain embedded in the stalled U.S.-Iran framework, but no canonical warning indicator crosses threshold; raw/coupled risk holds 56/64

dashboard_trackers.name: IRAN WAR
dashboard_trackers.notes: Reuters reports the UAE accused Iran of attacking two ADNOC-linked vessels in the Strait of Hormuz, while Washington said its naval blockade can continue indefinitely and threatened further economic pressure. The fresh shipping attacks activate canonical ceasefire_violation alongside diplomacy_active and hormuz_controlled_not_closed. Raw/coupled risk remains at the 95/100 ceiling

dashboard_trackers.name: ISRAEL-LEBANON
dashboard_trackers.notes: Reuters reports Israel will not withdraw from southern Lebanon until Hezbollah is disarmed and ordered preparations for an extended presence; Hezbollah rejects weapons talks before Israeli withdrawal. Canonical diplomacy_refused joins active diplomacy and ceasefire-violation signals. Raw/coupled risk remains at the 95/100 ceiling

dashboard_trackers.name: TURKEY-NATO
dashboard_trackers.notes: Reuters reports Türkiye, Pakistan and Saudi Arabia will create political and military coordination mechanisms under their defence pact. The allied restructuring is material, but the public text contains no atomic-sharing provision or other configured warning threshold. Risk holds 5/deterrent

dashboard_trackers.name: INDIA-PAKISTAN
dashboard_trackers.notes: Pakistan's prime minister called Indus waters a red line and threatened a direct response if India withheld water. This is escalatory rhetoric, but India has no configured rhetoric signal and no fresh operational military buildup was independently verified. Risk holds 15/elevated

dashboard_trackers.name: PAKISTAN-AFGHANISTAN
dashboard_trackers.notes: Indexes carried claims of renewed Durand Line clashes, but timely independent corroboration was insufficient and several results recycled older confrontations. No new configured signal is applied; risk holds 46/critical

dashboard_trackers.name: RUSSIA-UKRAINE
dashboard_trackers.notes: Reuters reports Ukraine offered Russia a mutual halt to attacks on civilian Black Sea targets, but no Russian acceptance was reported and strikes continued against ports, refineries and military infrastructure. A unilateral proposal does not yet establish active negotiations. No configured signal changes; risk holds at the 99 ceiling

dashboard_trackers.name: RUSSIA-NATO
dashboard_trackers.notes: Reuters reports NATO mission jets shot down an unidentified drone that entered Latvian airspace; Latvia initially gave no origin, and no injury or damage was reported. NATO's 12 August statement separately held Russia responsible for recent Polish and Romanian airspace violations and described increasing risk tolerance. The fresh defensive interception reinforces the existing eastern-flank assessment but does not establish a direct Russia-NATO exchange or a configured warning threshold. Raw/coupled risk holds 70/80

dashboard_trackers.name: CHINA-TAIWAN
dashboard_trackers.notes: Taiwan rehearsed communications degradation during a civil-defence drill. This is resilience preparation, not a fresh PRC military_buildup event. No new PRC deployment or blockade action was verified; raw/coupled risk holds 24/29

dashboard_trackers.name: DPRK
dashboard_trackers.notes: Reuters confirms another ballistic missile launch from Wonsan toward the east coast ahead of Aug. 17-27 U.S.-ROK drills. It landed outside Japan’s EEZ. Canonical missile_range_test is renewed; no nuclear test or strike on another state was reported. Risk holds 24/elevated

dashboard_trackers.name: SUDAN
dashboard_trackers.notes: Reuters reports the RSF renewed its assault on al-Obeid, eight drones targeted the city, first-since-May drone strikes reached Khartoum and Atbara, and both the army and RSF recently reinforced Kordofan. Canonical military_buildup and infrastructure_strike activate. Risk rises 94→99, constrained below certainty despite active war

dashboard_trackers.name: ISRAEL PALESTINE
dashboard_trackers.notes: Al Jazeera reports Israeli strikes killed Gaza City police chief Tareq Marouf and other Palestinians, while Israel said one strike targeted a Hamas commander planning attacks. This reconfirms the existing truce-breach warning; the tracker remains at its 99/IMMINENT ceiling

dashboard_trackers.name: SOUTH SUDAN ABYEI
dashboard_trackers.notes: No fresh independently corroborated Abyei clash, force movement or diplomatic implementation event surfaced in the review window. Risk holds 19/elevated

dashboard_trackers.name: EASTERN DRC
dashboard_trackers.notes: No new independently corroborated M23/FARDC battlefield or implementation event surfaced in the past-24h indexes. The older diplomacy_active instance has expired; risk holds 53/imminent pending verified implementation or renewed fighting

dashboard_trackers.name: YEMEN RED SEA
dashboard_trackers.notes: Reuters reports the U.N. envoy warned Yemen faces its most serious threat of a return to large-scale war since the 2022 cessation of major hostilities, with intensified front-line fighting, cross-border attacks and renewed danger to Red Sea/Gulf of Aden shipping. The Houthis separately claimed a two-drone attack on Saudi Aramco's Jazan refinery; Saudi Arabia had not commented and damage was not confirmed. The existing breach warning remains active and infrastructure_strike is renewed. Risk holds 90/IMMINENT because these events reinforce risks already priced rather than establish a separate new threshold

dashboard_trackers.name: MALI SAHEL
dashboard_trackers.notes: Reuters reports Mali's army said 82 soldiers held since the April nationwide attacks were freed through a planned operation. The release is material but was not reported as a negotiated ceasefire or a durable reduction in JNIM/FLA capability. No configured signal changes; risk holds 43/critical

dashboard_trackers.name: SOUTH CHINA SEA
dashboard_trackers.notes: No fresh collision, armed exchange, deployment or diplomatic breakthrough was verified after the prior Scarborough pressure. Risk holds 35/critical

dashboard_trackers.name: SOMALIA GULF OF ADEN
dashboard_trackers.notes: No fresh piracy boarding was verified. A Chinese escort-taskforce rotation is maritime-security posture rather than hostile external backing; risk holds 28/critical

dashboard_trackers.name: SOUTHERN THAILAND
dashboard_trackers.notes: No fresh independently corroborated attack, deployment or diplomatic event surfaced. Risk holds 30/critical

dashboard_trackers.name: KUWAIT IRAQ BORDER
dashboard_trackers.notes: No fresh hostile-drone or border-strike event was verified. Risk holds 30/critical

dashboard_trackers.name: IRAQ INTERNAL CONFLICT
dashboard_trackers.notes: Iraq continued efforts to reassure Riyadh over militia-linked drone activity, but no fresh confirmed attack, delivery or refusal event crossed threshold. Older active instances expired; risk holds 45/critical

dashboard_trackers.name: KENYA SOMALIA BORDER
dashboard_trackers.notes: No new large-scale al-Shabaab attack or security-force buildup was verified in the review window. Risk holds 25/critical

dashboard_trackers.name: EGYPT MEDITERRANEAN
dashboard_trackers.notes: Saudi rerouting through Egypt’s Mediterranean infrastructure reflects Red Sea disruption, not a fresh strike on Egyptian facilities. Risk holds 20/elevated

dashboard_trackers.name: SPAIN MOROCCO CEUTA
dashboard_trackers.notes: Morocco publicly renewed sovereignty claims over Ceuta and Melilla; Madrid said their status is not up for discussion, and Morocco tightened border security ahead of online calls for another mass crossing. The interstate dispute sharpens the watch but does not meet an operational threshold; risk holds 22/elevated

dashboard_trackers.name: ETHIOPIA TIGRAY
dashboard_trackers.notes: No fresh clash was independently verified. The older force_mobilization indicator remains within its configured 168-hour event window but is heavily decayed; risk holds 32/critical pending new ENDF/TPLF movement or a verified halt

allied_positions.nato: NATO mission jets shot down an unidentified drone over Latvia on 14 August. Latvia initially gave no origin. NATO's 12 August North Atlantic Council statement blamed Russia for recent Polish and Romanian airspace violations, called them dangerous and unacceptable, and said eastern-flank air and missile defences are being strengthened; no Article 4/5 activation was reported.
allied_positions.middle_east_allies: Türkiye, Pakistan and Saudi Arabia are setting up defence-minister, foreign-minister and military-chief coordination mechanisms and planning exercises under their pact. No public nuclear-sharing provision or deployed joint force was verified.
allied_positions.israel_lebanon: Withdrawal and Hezbollah-disarmament conditions remain deadlocked while southern strikes and talks continue; no implementation breakthrough was verified.
allied_positions.ukraine_partners: Ukraine proposed a mutual halt to attacks on civilian Black Sea targets, but no Russian acceptance was reported. NATO support and eastern-flank defensive measures continue as port, refinery and airspace incidents persist.
allied_positions.asia_pacific: U.S.-ROK Ulchi Freedom Shield remains scheduled for 17-27 August after the latest DPRK ballistic launch. Taiwan-U.S. coast-guard coordination and PRC patrol pressure continue, but no fresh ICBM, nuclear test, blockade or armed South China Sea collision was verified.
allied_positions.iaea_un: Direct IAEA Iran-page extraction failed and the official index did not expose a newer safeguards report. No fresh enrichment, access, Fordow, reprocessing or nuclear-test threshold was verified. The U.N. warning that Yemen faces its highest major-war risk since the 2022 truce remains current.
allied_positions.maritime: UKMTO's public recent-incidents page showed zero live cards, while Reuters, the U.N. and the IEA continued to document severe Hormuz and Red Sea disruption. Missing live cards were not treated as normalization.

summary: Global risk holds at 86/IMMINENT. The material follow-up is renewed Hormuz shipping violence: Reuters reports the UAE accused Iran of attacks on two ADNOC-linked vessels while the U.S. said its blockade can continue indefinitely. iran_conventional:ceasefire_violation activates, but the tracker is already at the 95 raw / 100 coupled ceiling.

The IEA August report still records an effectively closed Hormuz lane, 8.3 mb/d of Gulf output shut in and a projected 4.3 mb/d global supply decline in 2026; modest futures moves are not treated as military signals.
